mechanisms.name: `--enable-annotation-validation` on by default (#11819)
mechanisms.mechanism: Annotation validation is now enabled by default, so invalid or disallowed annotations on Ingresses would be rejected.
mechanisms.mitigationOrNoExposure: The only annotation is `ssl-redirect: "false"`, a valid boolean. It is a low-risk annotation, so it is not rejected by validation or by the risk level. Nothing in the repo overrides `--enable-annotation-validation`, so the new default applies.
assumptions: The repo's `docs` Ingress is the only Ingress (the overlay and cluster Applications add no others)
ORIENTATION says nothing is applied by hand
missingEvidence: Other Ingresses or annotations created outside this repo (other teams, controllers, or other clusters' repos reusing the shared `values.yaml`)
recommendedValidation: Server-side dry-run (`kubectl apply --dry-run=server` of `apps/docs`) against a staging cluster with the 1.12.0 webhook, confirming the `ssl-redirect` annotation is admitted
Inventory other Ingresses in the live cluster (`kubectl get ingress -A -o yaml`)

mechanisms.name: `annotations-risk-level` lowered to High (#11819)
mechanisms.mechanism: The new default blocks "Critical" annotations, such as `configuration-snippet`, `server-snippet` and `auth-snippet`.
mechanisms.mitigationOrNoExposure: None of the Critical annotations are used; `ssl-redirect` is low risk. There is no snippet or auth annotation on the Ingress. No `annotations-risk-level` override exists, so the new default applies.
citedEvidence: `env/apps/docs/base/ingress.yaml`: only `ssl-redirect` annotation; no snippet or auth annotation
assumptions: No Ingresses beyond the repo's `docs` Ingress (hidden consumers out of scope)
missingEvidence: Live-cluster Ingresses not declared in this repo that may use snippet annotations
recommendedValidation: Inventory other Ingresses in the live cluster (`kubectl get ingress -A -o yaml`) for snippet annotations

mechanisms.name: `allow-cross-namespace-resources` disabled (#11819)
mechanisms.mechanism: This option governs references to Secrets in other namespaces (`auth-secret`, `auth-tls-secret`, `proxy-ssl-secret` and similar); with it disabled, such cross-namespace references would be disallowed.
mechanisms.mitigationOrNoExposure: The Ingress has no such annotations, no TLS section and no secret reference. Its backends `docs-site` and `wellknown` are in the same namespace (kustomize sets `docs`).
citedEvidence: `env/apps/docs/base/ingress.yaml`: no TLS section, no secret reference
assumptions: No Ingresses beyond the repo's `docs` Ingress
missingEvidence: Live-cluster Ingresses with cross-namespace secret annotations not declared in this repo
recommendedValidation: Inventory other Ingresses in the live cluster (`kubectl get ingress -A -o yaml`) for cross-namespace secret annotations

mechanisms.name: `strict-validate-path-type` enabled (#11819)
mechanisms.claimedClassQuote: The one residual risk is the `strict-validate-path-type` check
resourcesConsumers: Argo CD sync of the Ingress
mechanisms.mechanism: Strict path validation may reject the `/.well-known` path (a segment starting with a dot). If rejected, the failure would show at admission when Argo CD syncs the Ingress; if the controller's runtime sync also applies the check, the Ingress could be skipped and the route would drop.
mechanisms.mitigationOrNoExposure: Both paths use `Prefix`, neither is a regex or `ImplementationSpecific`. From memory, strict validation rejects characters outside an alphanumeric, `-`, `_`, `.` and `/` class and regex-like or `//` paths; if so, `/.well-known` passes because `.` is allowed. This was not checked: the supplied upstream files contain only the changelog line. Existing Ingresses are not re-admitted on a controller upgrade. Rollback mitigation: set `controller.config.strict-validate-path-type: "false"` or pin chart 4.11.5.
assumptions: The strict validation character class (from memory) allows `.`
The controller does not rewrite the path
missingEvidence: 1.12.0 controller source or docs showing the exact path regex
Whether the controller's runtime sync also applies the check (cannot be settled from the supplied material)
recommendedValidation: Server-side dry-run (`kubectl apply --dry-run=server` of `apps/docs`) in staging on 1.12.0, confirming the `/.well-known` Prefix path is admitted
Inspect the 1.12.0 source or docs for the exact path regex

Post-upgrade smoke test: fetch `https://docs.example.com/` and `/.well-known/security.txt`; check controller logs for "invalid" or "skipping ingress"; check the generated nginx.conf contains the `/.well-known` location
Rollback plan: pin chart 4.11.5 in `clusters/prod/ingress-nginx.yaml`; or set `controller.config.strict-validate-path-type: "false"`

mechanisms.mitigationOrNoExposure: No metrics, ServiceMonitor or PodMonitor are configured here. Anything that scraped the controller would already have been failing.

mechanisms.name: Admission jobs use `kube-webhook-certgen` v1.5.0 (older than v1.5.2 in the 1.11.5 render)
mechanisms.mechanism: The 1.12.0 render's admission jobs use an older certgen image (v1.5.0) than the 1.11.5 render (v1.5.2).
recommendedValidation: Check that the v1.5.0 versus v1.5.2 discrepancy is intended

mechanisms.name: `runAsGroup` newly set (82 on controller, 65532 on jobs)
resourcesConsumers: any Pod Security or admission policy in the cluster
mechanisms.mechanism: New `runAsGroup` values on controller and job pods could conflict with cluster Pod Security or admission policy.
missingEvidence: Cluster Pod Security or admission policy
recommendedValidation: Confirm the new `runAsGroup` values against any Pod Security or admission policy in the cluster

overall.recommendation: Proceed with conditions. The engineer judges the upgrade probably safe, but the `/.well-known` path under `strict-validate-path-type` is unverified and needs an admission test (server-side dry-run in staging) before rollout. They also list a source/docs check, a post-upgrade smoke test, an inventory of other Ingresses, checks of the certgen version and `runAsGroup` values, and a rollback plan.
overall.quote: Probably not, but one item is unverified. ... It needs a quick admission test before rollout
